purpose: Test whether explicit abstention on ordinary setups improves conditional expectancy. This sprint separates earning more research from proving a persistent edge.

method_change.principle: The strategy may remain in cash when opportunity quality is not high enough.
method_change.why: Prior sprints often forced a daily portfolio even when score separation or market state was weak. Sprint 11 tests predeclared opportunity qualification instead of treating every signal as equally tradeable.
method_change.inactive_state: 100% cash with real turnover costs charged on entry and exit

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal day
execution.rebalance: daily including transitions to and from cash

opportunity_gate.threshold_timing: quality threshold at signal t uses only quality observations strictly before t

selective_trend_acceleration_5d.provenance: New hypothesis generated from Sprint 7/8 diagnostics; not a rescue of those families.
selective_trend_acceleration_5d.score: sum of the most recent 5 completed close-to-close daily returns minus the sum of the preceding 5 completed daily returns
selective_trend_acceleration_5d.direction: long highest two acceleration scores and short lowest two
selective_trend_acceleration_5d.state_gate: BTC Wilder ADX14 >= 25 using information through the prior completed daily close
selective_trend_acceleration_5d.opportunity_quality: cross-sectional P80 minus P20 of acceleration scores
selective_trend_acceleration_5d.opportunity_rule: state gate true AND current quality > strictly-prior 60-day 75th percentile
principal_controls: same score traded every eligible trend day without opportunity-quality gate

selective_low_skew_90d.provenance: New hypothesis generated from Sprint 10 low-skew diagnostics; Sprint 10 family remains falsified.
selective_low_skew_90d.score: negative unbiased sample skewness of the most recent 90 completed close-to-close daily returns
selective_low_skew_90d.direction: long lowest-skew two and short highest-skew two
selective_low_skew_90d.opportunity_quality: cross-sectional P80 minus P20 of the negative-skew score
principal_controls: same score traded every eligible day without opportunity gate

selective_funding_carry_14d.provenance: New hypothesis generated from Sprint 9 isolated 14-day funding-carry result; Sprint 9 family remains falsified.
selective_funding_carry_14d.score: negative realized funding burden per calendar day over the strictly prior 14 calendar days
selective_funding_carry_14d.direction: long lowest funding-burden two and short highest funding-burden two
selective_funding_carry_14d.opportunity_quality: cross-sectional P80 minus P20 of the carry score
principal_controls: same score traded every eligible day without opportunity gate

d0_research_candidate_gate.selection: Each family has one frozen selective rule. No parameter competition and no choosing the best threshold.

evidence_boundary.research_candidate_means: deserves freeze and hostile validation, not established edge
evidence_boundary.required_path_after_D0: candidate freeze -> independent reproduction -> D2 source replication -> D3 non-overlapping temporal -> D4 prospective shadow
